# Glossary notes

- **Net Promoter Score**: A survey metric that asks how likely customers are to recommend the company, scored from -100 to 100.
- **Backlog Grooming**: The regular meeting where the team reorders and clarifies upcoming work items for the next sprint.

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| Service Level Agreement | A written commitment that sets the response time and uptime a customer can expect. |
